Naomi — quick summary from Legal/Contracts:
- We can accept a customer PO as long as the PO is non-contingent and references the final agreement date and Redwood invoice terms. However, contracts must be countersigned within 5 business days of PO to keep the commercial terms locked.
- Redlines: I've attached our suggested comment pass (redlines_acme_legal.pdf). Nothing material — a few standard warranty/usage clarifications and one data-retention paragraph (they requested 7y; we prefer 3y with enterprise add-on options).
- Exec approvals: No C-level signoff required for the agreed pricing band; for any deviations >10% off list pricing, Naomi, we'll need sales leader approval.

DocuSign is fine. Suggest we send DocuSign with an explicit 72-hour signature window for primary signers to keep momentum. If they need PO-first, procurement must include the expected signers and sign-off SLA in the PO.

Karthik
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Jordan / Anita — thanks for the quick note and the MAP. Below is our proposed decision matrix and next steps so your committee can have a crisp go/hold conversation next week.

Decision matrix (summary):
- Go (preferred): PO submitted and non-contingent referencing final agreement date by 2026-08-02 -> Redwood countersigns by 2026-08-05 -> Dedicated capacity activation on 2026-08-09.
- Contingency (hold but limited ramp): PO submitted now and DocuSign route opened; Acme signs within 3 business days of DocuSign -> sandbox/soft-launch available 2026-07-26 with limited throughput; full SLA begins upon countersign.
- Hold: PO contingent on unresolved legal items beyond our comment pass; procurement hold will push start by 2+ weeks.

Logistics & choreography:
- Legal: Karthik will publish a clean contract version with tracked redlines accepted.
- E-sign: we'll generate a DocuSign envelope and share link. Link (for tracking): https://docusign.com/rc/ABCDEF123456
- Signature window: recommended 72-hour primary signer window. If signers require more time, please flag and we'll convert to PO-first acceptance with countersign timeline to protect pricing and capacity slot.
- PO-first: acceptable provided PO references final agreement date and expected signers; countersign must occur within 5 business days to lock pricing.
- Start date: Monica confirms we can provision Dedicated capacity for 2026-08-09 if contract countersign is complete by 2026-08-02.

Attachments included in thread: Acme-MAP-v3.pdf, redlines_acme_legal.pdf, capacity-alloc.xlsx

Next steps (simple timeline):
1) Acme procurement (Anita) to confirm PO policy and whether you will send a non-contingent PO or require e-sign first (please reply by EOD Tuesday, 2026-07-21).
2) Karthik to publish clean contract and share DocuSign envelope (ETA 24 hours after Anita confirms).
3) Acme signers to sign within 72 hours of DocuSign or confirm alternative timeline.
4) Redwood to countersign within 5 business days of PO to preserve pricing & slot.

If this plan looks good I'll send the DocuSign envelope and a one-page acceptance summary for your committee pack.

Appreciate the pace — happy to jump on a 15-min call tomorrow if useful.
